scope: Approval parts current-self in-app messages; not email, replay management or full FR-NOTIFY acceptance

security.ingress: TLS EdgeFilter gateway-notification; public requests never choose actor/tenant
security.write: Current CSRF + allowed Origin; only self; online approval READ plus current identity reviewer/applicant eligibility before history replay

message.title: string
message.body: generic string without owner private text
message.readAt: UTC ISO instant|null; non-null iff read

routes.response: same read result; current object permission required; pure query

errors.400: VALIDATION_ERROR: extra/query/actor fields or invalid UUID/header/body
errors.403: current write origin/CSRF or edge denied
errors.404: TARGET_NOT_ACCESSIBLE; OPERATION_NOT_OBSERVED only on a missing original read operation
errors.409: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: same actor original UUID bound to another message
errors.503: dependency/storage/current authorization cannot be proved; query only, no new UUID

recovery: 401/403 never enable retry. After unknown POST query original read operation; only explicit OPERATION_NOT_OBSERVED404 allows same original UUID+same target explicit resubmit. Late replies remain bound to identity generation/component/target/original UUID. No GET writes.

body.event: canonical DomainEvent map, exact one top-level key; authority/recipients forbidden

internal.atomicity: event_inbox and all actual notification_message rows commit in one local physical transaction; ACK only after commit; same event UUID different envelope409
internal.recipients: resolve immutable owner notification-context DELIVERY exact event match, then current identity eligibility; submitted and terminal current reviewers plus eligible applicant; no reviewer still current applicant. No browser actor or event payload authority.

bounds.exceeded: 503 explicit failure; never truncate total and claim complete

evidence: Local H2/MVC/adapter/wiring only until BE-0 real TLS/MySQL/browser evidence; do not label local tests real deployment
